newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tiger kills Japanese couple in safari park.
newsitem.headline: Tiger kills Japanese couple in safari park.

text.p: An elderly Japanese couple were mauled to death by a Bengal tiger at a safari park near Tokyo on Saturday, but managed to save their three-month-old grandson who escaped unharmed.
The attack occurred in an area of the Gunma Safari World park, northwest of Tokyo, where tigers roam freely and visitors are told to stay in their vehicles.

The 60-year-old woman defied the warnings and got out of the car carrying the baby, Kyodo news agency reported. When she was attacked, her husband, 64, managed to get the child to safety before being set upon as well.
Both died of their injuries in hospital.
The incident was the worst at the park since 1983, when a lion got onto a tour bus and seriously injured a guide.
